'''Volpai''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Tiggs Leo/Legends|Tiggs Leo]] was a member of this species.

==Biology and Description==
Volpai had multiple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and four [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. They were rather skinny with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin with violet stripes.

==History==
[[File:PlopDribbles-Brothers.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Volpai in Plop Dribble's.]]
On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a bartender named [[Tiggs Leo/Legends|Tiggs Leo]] was a member of this species. Another Volpai could be found at [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]].
